title: 罗森式
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、左、右。上段攻击、两次左击后，以右击收尾，偏开对手剑并击中头部。
second_page: 此招式把敌人的剑一步步推离中线。最后一击不变换角度，顺着空隙切入头部。翻到这里，你已经开始练习罗森式。

en_us.title: Rossen
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Left, Left, Right. Follow an overhead attack with two left strikes, then finish from the right to displace the opponent's sword and strike the head.
en_us.second_page: This technique pushes the enemy's blade away from the centerline one step at a time. The final strike enters the opening and cuts into the head.
